The '''Lost Prince''' was an infamous [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] heir apparent who was kidnapped as a child 20 years before the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. A Falleen imposter eventually revealed that he was the son of the original kidnappers and that the real prince had [[Death/Legends|died]] years ago.<ref name="Son" />
